annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a recorded, analytical crypto experiment and explicitly disclaims being a guide, promotion, endorsement, or promise of results. The named platform, reported returns, and trading-position rule are framed as personal testing and demonstration rather than encouragement to invest. Although the free-USDT wording and withdrawal submission create ambiguity, the available video evidence says the withdrawal completion and reported results are not established.
